docs.title: 👋 About Me
docs.text: Hey there! I'm Hussnain Ali, a passionate Data Scientist 🧠 from Pakistan 🇵🇰 with a deep interest in applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to solve real-world challenges — especially in agriculture, health, and business analytics 🌾📊💼.

docs.title: 🚀 My Mission
docs.text:
To harness the power of data and AI to create intelligent systems that make decision-making smarter, faster, and more sustainable. I believe in transforming raw data into actionable insights that drive innovation and impact.

“Data is not just numbers — it’s the story of reality waiting to be understood.”

docs.title: 💡 What I Do
docs.text:
• 🤖 Build and train Machine Learning models for prediction, classification, and clustering
  • 🧩 Design AI-driven applications using tools like LangChain, OpenAI, and Streamlit
  • 🗂️ Perform data preprocessing and feature engineering for model optimization
  • 📊 Create interactive data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, and Plotly
  • 🧠 Research and experiment with NLP, Deep Learning, and Computer Vision
